title: the token times · a monthly newspaper on the ai industry
excerpt: The Token Times is a monthly broadsheet on what the AI industry actually did — models, money, launches, and the models that got retired. Read every edition online, free, or download the print PDF. Published by failproof ai.
content_html:
monthly editionno. 1

estd. 2026jul–aug 2026

eight pages of ai industry reporting, once a month. model prices, funding rounds, launches, and an obituary page for the models that got retired.

published by failproof ai · free, for your email

current editionno. 1

jul–aug 2026 · 8 pages · published aug 24, 2026

unreleased openai model settles 10 open math problems for just $2000

an openai model the public cannot use answers a question mathematicians left open for 27 years — then gets slowed on cyber six days later. plus jeff dean leaves google, stripe buys openrouter, and gpt-5.6 luna drops 80 percent.

inside this edition

  • 01front pagean unreleased openai model settles 10 open math problems for about $2,000 in tokens — then is slowed on cyber grounds six days later.
  • 02the people pagejeff dean leaves google after 27 years, and does not leave alone. alphabet funds the leaving party at $10b.
  • 03the consolidationstripe buys openrouter for more than $7b, and the new form of payments is in tokens.
  • 04indiasarvam puts a six-month clock on a trillion-parameter model built from scratch in india.
  • 05failproof aia word from the paper’s publisher.
  • 06money mattersforty unicorns in july, the highest monthly count in four years. four deals took nearly a third of it.
  • 07launch padcapy sells faith in agents, lemma sells doubt, and both work.
  • 08the token exchangethe price board: luna off 80 percent, and the spread to sol is now 25x on input. plus an obituary for claude opus 4.1.

engineers, founders and researchers who get the paper each month.
